theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (ι : Fin n → Fin P) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), StrictMono ι → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ i, (∀ j, ι j ≠ i) → a i = x i) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ))) ∨ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = -α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)))) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (ι : Fin n → Fin P) (c : Euclid P) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → StrictMono ι → MeasurableSet E → (∀ a ∈ E, ∀ i, (∀ j, ι j ≠ i) → a i = c i) → ∃ σ : Euclid P → ℤ, Measurable σ ∧ (∀ x, |σ x| ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ E)), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, R.orient x α = (σ x : ℝ) * α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ))
